audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) gave the stage to Sett while whys[6], spikes[3].text and late all say the lane evens out as full-tank Sejuani scales.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill at row 6; the page's own prose already says the 1v1 edge fades.
audit.corrected: Row 6 -> Skill in both layers with the rating dropped to 5/10. Rows 0-5 left with Sett, matching the packet and the 53.62% win rate.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly timed: Facebreaker at 3, The Show Stopper at 6 (120/100/80s), first item, and Sejuani's full-tank late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Facebreaker was written as an unconditional grab-stun, and Permafrost was treated as a cooldown to bait. Both are wrong.
audit.why: Facebreaker stuns only when enemies are on OPPOSITE sides of Sett; on one side it slows — and Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so a clean 1v1 pull into an out-of-combat Sejuani lands nothing. Permafrost is on a 1.5s cooldown and cannot be baited; the gate is her Frost stacks from Winter's Wrath (9s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns. Matches the already-audited mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wrong pronoun for Sejuani in dontsFull[0].t, report[11].t and dosFull[2].t ('his Permafrost', 'E-stun him').
audit.why: Sejuani is female; the templated strings were never gendered.
audit.corrected: Rewritten and re-pointed at the Frost stacks and the minion wave.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost (1.5s): you cannot wait it out — deny the Frost stacks instead. Winter's Wrath is 9s at rank 1; that is the real gate.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost is 1.5s — dodge the Frost stacks, not the stun. Step out of Winter's Wrath before it caps.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — E-stun into the W panel.
edits.after: Facebreaker only stuns with enemies on both sides — solo, it slows, and Frost Armor makes her immune to slows. Pull her over minions.
Eat her Frost stacks for free

edits.before: E-stun him when Permafrost is down
edits.after: E-stun her over your minion wave

edits.before: Eat his Permafrost for free. W early before grit is banked. Chase past the river with no vision. The Show Stopper is your fight-flipper — without it you have no gap close onto the carry.
edits.after: Eat her Frost stacks for free. W early before grit is banked. E her with nothing behind her — Frost Armor shrugs the slow. The Show Stopper is your fight-flipper onto the carry.
